actions.subject: Open lines HPO-26-00404/10 and HPO-26-00652/10, Gearbox planetary HR-12210: firm dates and terms
actions.body:
Dear Katrin Vogel,

We have two open lines with you for Gearbox, planetary (HR-12210). One of them is past due (marked below).

HPO-26-00404/10 · Gearbox, planetary (HR-12210) · 199 EA · promised 24 September (past due)
HPO-26-00652/10 · Gearbox, planetary (HR-12210) · 139 EA · promised 20 November

1. Please give us a firm ship date for each line.
2. Please confirm both lines will ship on normal payment terms, with no prepayment. We understand your company is in an insolvency procedure; please also tell us whether the court-appointed monitor has confirmed that open orders will be fulfilled.
3. We would like a bridge quantity of Gearbox, planetary (HR-12210) on normal payment terms, without prepayment. Please tell us what quantity you can supply on those terms and the earliest delivery date.
4. For quote AN-2026-1187, Gearbox, planetary (HR-12210): please tell us whether the quoted prices hold for a bridge order placed on those terms before the quote lapses on 31 October.

Please reply by 24 October, and sooner if you can.

Nothing in this email waives any of Halden's rights under the agreement.

Best regards,
Dana Reyes
Halden Robotics

actions.body:

actions.subject: New dates on HPO-26-00623 and revised dates for HPO-26-00554 lines 30 and 40
actions.body:
Dear Zhou Hui,

Thank you for your notice of 24 September about the cyberattack and the schedule change. Could you please confirm that the new dates on HPO-26-00623 lines 10, 20 and 30 still hold now that your systems are being restored, and that the first shipment on 9 October is on schedule? For HPO-26-00554 lines 30 and 40, which are past due and have no new date in your mail, please give us a revised promise date for each and tell us what will ship.

Three of these five lines were already past due on 25 September (marked below).

HPO-26-00623/10 · Harness, lidar power and ethernet (HR-21107) · 890 EA · promised 28 September, now 30 October
HPO-26-00623/20 · Harness, main distribution (HR-21111) · 115 EA · promised 24 September, now 20 November (past due)
HPO-26-00623/30 · Harness, fork actuator and sensors (HR-21112) · 270 EA · promised 28 September, now 30 October
HPO-26-00554/30 · Harness, drive motor power and hall (HR-21109) · promised 24 September, no new date (past due)
HPO-26-00554/40 · Harness, battery 48 V (HR-21110) · promised 21 September, no new date (past due)

Please reply as soon as you can, and by 9 October.

Please send the country of origin (where it is made, not where it ships from) and the HTS classification you use for the Harness, tote lift motor and limit switches (HR-21106), with proof such as a certificate of origin. Please reply by 15 October.

Nothing in this email accepts the notice or waives any of Halden's rights under the agreement.

Best regards,
Priya Nair
Halden Robotics
